questions.text: I was born on 19 Nov 2003 at 10:30 AM in Madurai. Can you calculate my full navamsa chart?

questions.key: Does NOT calculate. Says the current bhukti is Rahu bhukti until Mar 2029 and the list of later bhuktis is not in the chart.

questions.text: Kalyanam eppo? Endha graham en 7th house la irukku?
questions.key: The 7th house from Magaram lagnam is Kadagam and no planet sits there in this chart. Must not place any planet in the 7th house.

questions.text: My 10th house la enna planet irukku? Govt job varuma?
questions.key: Ketu is in Thulam, the 10th house from Magaram lagnam; no other planet is there. Must not invent another planet in the 10th.
Says Venus's navamsa position is not in the chart it has (only Rahu and Ketu navamsa are given); does not name a sign.

questions.text: 2027 la Guru endha rasi ku peyarchi aagum? Adhu en rasikku nallatha?
questions.key: Says the chart only shows this year's transits (Guru in Simmam now, Jenma Guru for Simmam rasi) and does not state a 2027 sign or date as a fact from the chart.

questions.text: Sani en jathagathula endha veetla irukkaru?

questions.text: Ippo Guru enga irukkaru, adhu enakku nallatha?
questions.key: Today Guru is in Simmam, 1st from Simmam rasi (Jenma Guru). Birth Guru is also in Simmam (8th from lagnam). Does not give another sign or house.
